capture_method: sandbox page-fetch tool, one canonical URL per request (FDA Drugs@FDA application pages, openFDA API JSON, Wayback Machine)
purpose: Live re-verification of the 1983-1985 flagged rows: the 1985 Tambocor designation conflict, the four 1985 master applications the committed payloads cannot enumerate (Seldane, Protropin, Suprol, Femstat), and the legacy-1983 blank-class condition that the NDA022046 lineage question also turns on.

captures.subject: NDA 018830 Tambocor (flecainide acetate) - 1985 designation conflict
captures.finding_verbatim: Company: ALVOGEN. Products on NDA 018830: TAMBOCOR / FLECAINIDE ACETATE 100MG, 200MG, 150MG, 50MG, TABLET;ORAL, all Marketing Status 'Discontinued' each carrying '**Federal Register determination that product was not discontinued or withdrawn for safety or effectiveness reasons**'. Original Approvals: '10/31/1985 | ORIG-1 | Approval | Type 1 - New Molecular Entity | STANDARD' with link 'Review (PDF)' -> https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/pre96/018830Orig1s000rev.pdf and note 'Label is not available on this site.' Supplements listed: SUPPL-24 (09/22/2016) label+letter; SUPPL-20 (04/28/2000); SUPPL-19 (09/03/1999).
captures.project_effect: Third FDA-family corroboration of STANDARD (openFDA payload record, payload-derived audit row, and now the live Drugs@FDA page). The master keeps the Compilation's 'Priority' per COMPILATION_ONLY policy and records this conflict; nothing was harmonised.

captures.subject: NDA 018615 Sulfatrim (sulfamethoxazole; trimethoprim) - legacy 1983 original with no published classification
captures.finding_verbatim: Company: PHARM ASSOC. Products: SULFATRIM 200MG/5ML;40MG/5ML SUSPENSION;ORAL (Discontinued) and SULFATRIM PEDIATRIC (Prescription, TE code AB). Original Approvals: '01/07/1983 | ORIG-1 | Approval | (Submission Classification cell blank) | (Review Priority; Orphan Status cell blank)' with 'Label is not available on this site.' 43 supplements listed, the earliest dated 02/13/1986.
captures.project_effect: Confirms the project's TRACKED_REVIEW condition is a genuine FDA source gap, not an extraction error: Drugs@FDA publishes this 1983 original with blank Submission Classification and blank Review Priority, exactly as the committed openFDA payload does.

captures.subject: NDA 018949 Seldane (terfenadine) - 1985 master row not enumerable from the committed payloads
captures.project_effect: The application is wholly absent from openFDA's Drugs@FDA dataset (not merely missing an ORIG/AP submission).

captures.subject: NDA 018949 Seldane - Drugs@FDA page render
captures.finding_verbatim: The page renders the Drugs@FDA shell for 'New Drug Application (NDA)' with NO company line, NO products table and NO approval-history table - the application number resolves but FDA publishes no record content for it.
captures.project_effect: Precise wording for the master's completeness-gap note: FDA indexes the number but publishes no record; the Compilation row remains the sole FDA source for the 1985 approval date.

captures.subject: NDA 019107 Protropin (somatrem) - 1985 master row
captures.finding_verbatim: NOT_FOUND (query returned no records for NDA019107). Companion query https://api.fda.gov/drug/drugsfda.json?search=products.brand_name:%22PROTROPIN%22&limit=5 also returned NOT_FOUND - the brand name is absent from openFDA entirely.
captures.project_effect: Documents that Protropin is not in openFDA under either the Compilation's application number or its brand name; nothing in the live systems contradicts the Compilation row, and nothing corroborates it either.

captures.subject: NDA 019107 Protropin - Drugs@FDA page render
captures.finding_verbatim: Page renders the Drugs@FDA shell with NO company line, NO products table and NO approval-history table (same empty-record condition as NDA018949).
captures.project_effect: Same precise finding as Seldane; recorded for the 1985 reconciliation.

captures.subject: NDA 018217 Suprol (suprofen) and NDA 019215 Femstat (butoconazole nitrate) - 1985 master rows
captures.finding_verbatim: total: 1. NDA019215 IS present: sponsor_name 'ROCHE PALO', product FEMSTAT / BUTOCONAZOLE NITRATE 2% / CREAM;VAGINAL, marketing_status 'Discontinued', and the record carries NO 'submissions' array at all. NDA018217 (Suprol) is NOT returned by the query.
captures.project_effect: Refines the master's gap wording: Femstat IS in openFDA as a product record with no submission history (which is exactly why the ORIG/AP payload query could not enumerate it), while Suprol is absent from the dataset entirely. Two different conditions, previously described with one sentence.

captures.subject: NDA 018509 Baros Effervescent - Compilation 1985 row that openFDA does enumerate
captures.finding_verbatim: total: 1. NDA018509: sponsor_name 'MALLINCKRODT INC', ORIG submission number 1, submission_type 'ORIG', submission_status 'AP', submission_status_date '19850807', review_priority 'STANDARD', submission_class_code 'TYPE 1' ('Type 1 - New Molecular Entity'); product BAROS, active ingredients SODIUM BICARBONATE 460MG/GM and TARTARIC ACID 420MG/GM, GRANULE, EFFERVESCENT;ORAL, Discontinued. Supplements SUPPL-1 (1987-05-04), SUPPL-3 (1992-09-21), SUPPL-4 (1994-01-06).
captures.project_effect: Independently confirms the Compilation's Baros Effervescent row against Drugs@FDA as a Type 1, STANDARD original on 1985-08-07 - so it is not the source of the 1985 31-vs-30 difference. Protropin is the remaining one-row difference candidate.

captures.subject: NDA 018830 1985 review document (contemporaneous designation evidence)
captures.finding_verbatim: The Wayback Machine reports '5 captures' of this PDF, spanning 30 Mar 2021 - 30 Mar 2025, and serves the archived page shell for the 2024-09-29 capture. The raw replay endpoints (web/20240929073454id_/ and web/20240929073454if_/) both returned HTTP 500 to the automated fetcher on 2026-09-19, as did a direct fetch of the live FDA URL (HTTP 500 on 2026-09-18 and again on 2026-09-19). The 1985 medical review could not be read by automation.
captures.project_effect: The one remaining source that can settle the Tambocor designation is confirmed to exist and to be archived; it needs a human browser read (live FDA URL or the Wayback URL above). Also confirms the failure is not a URL-registration error: FDA's own page links exactly this path.

captures.subject: Furosemide - pre-1980 original approvals (duplicative-ingredient spot check + dataset-boundary probe)
captures.finding_verbatim: total: 4. One returned record carries an ORIG submission number 1 with submission_status 'AP', submission_status_date '19680320', submission_class_code 'TYPE 3' ('Type 3 - New Dosage Form'), review_priority 'PRIORITY' - i.e. a US original approval of furosemide in 1968, fifteen years before the 1983 furosemide 'original approvals' the project tracks.
captures.project_effect: Two findings. (1) The 1983 and 1984 furosemide strings in the blank-class inventory are re-approvals of a molecule first approved in 1968, which is the substantive evidence that those rows are not NMEs. (2) openFDA DOES serve pre-1980 ORIG/AP submission records, so the project's 1980 start is a payload-coverage choice, not an API boundary - a pre-1980 fetch job is feasible.

captures.subject: Furosemide - 1980-1984 original approvals incl. NDA018413
captures.finding_verbatim: total: 15. One returned record carries an ORIG submission number 1 with submission_status 'AP', submission_status_date '19831130' and NO submission_class_code and NO review_priority - matching the project's NDA018413 row (the pre-1985 table's single non-NME boundary row) exactly, including the blank classification.
captures.project_effect: Independently reproduces the 1983-11-30 blank-class condition for NDA018413 from the live API (the same condition the committed payload records), corroborating the pre-1985 table's NOT STATED values and the audit's TRACKED_REVIEW verdict.

captures.system: Committed FDA CDER NME Compilation workbook (local parse)
captures.subject: 1985 section of the Compilation - row-level re-derivation
captures.finding_verbatim: 1,387 data rows, 26-column header (Proprietary Name ... Notes); 1985 section = 31 rows, 18 'Priority' and 13 'Standard'; the Tambocor row reads: Tambocor | flecainide acetate | Riker | NDA | 18830 | Tablet | Oral | receipt 1982-12-21 | approval 1985-10-31 | year 1985 | designation 'Priority' | Orphan No | Accelerated N/A. Dataset-wide the NDA/BLA column holds 1,108 'NDA' and 279 'BLA' rows; all 31 of the 1985 rows are 'NDA'.
captures.project_effect: Proves the master's 'Priority' value traces to the Compilation cell itself (not a transcription error) and that the Compilation carries no BLA-typed row for 1985 - so the 31-vs-30 difference is not visible in that column.
